text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with a general status update, as well as a quarterly report on the three theatres (Sony Centre for the Performing Arts, St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts, Toronto Centre for the Arts).

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Received Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 5, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto for information. 2. Approved the Strategic Plan, as noted in Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (June 5, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (June 5, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential as it pertains to the security of the property of the municipality or local board. 4. Confirmed its actions in closed session issuing additional instructions to staff.
